name: College of Engineering room booking (Outlook Calendar)
handoffSteps: Sign in to Outlook Calendar with your Penn State account.
Click the day you want and start a new event.
Search for the building and location (for example “ECoRE Bldg” or “Leonhard Bldg”) to see that building's rooms.
Add the room and the time shown here, then send the request.
You'll get an email if the reservation is approved. Until then, it isn't booked.

verification.note: The official page says 'Outlook Calendar' but gives no link; portalUrl is Outlook on the web, which Penn State Microsoft 365 accounts use.

name: Penn State University Libraries (LibCal)
handoffSteps: The room's page opens on your date. Tap your start time on its calendar, then choose the end time (up to 3 hours a day).
Enter your details, including your Penn State access ID.
Watch for the email confirmation. It isn't reserved until that arrives.
